description:
Utils: derive HD wallet (xPub, yPub, zPub) change or receiving addresses without syncing.

GET /utils/{blockchain}/{network}/xpubs/{extendedPublicKey}/derive-addresses
Derives up to 10 addresses. By default creates receiving/deposit address; set isChange=true for change address (UTXO only).

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• binance-smart-chain: 25
• bitcoin: 10
• bitcoin-cash: 12
• dash: 11
• dogecoin: 11
• ethereum: 10
• ethereum-classic: 13
• litecoin: 11
• tron: 15
• xrp: 10
• zcash: 13

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

addressesCount.description: Number of addresses to derive (up to 10)

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

isChange.description: If true derive change address(es); if false derive receiving/deposit

name: utils__derive_addresses
